name: Bari Aloo Tofu
ingredients: 1 tomato, jeera, hing and 1 tsp oil
steps: Add potato and water; cook until tender.
Add bari and tofu; simmer until bari softens.
note: Check packaged bari for sodium and ingredients.

inspirationReferences.title: Punjabi Wadi | Vadi Recipe
inspirationReferences.note: Punjabi sun-dried lentil wadi tradition and how wadis soften while simmering in vegetable gravies; our tofu-aloo treatment is original.
